The '''2017–18 Czech First League''', known as the '''[[Czech First League|HET liga]]''' for sponsorship reasons, was the 25th season of the [[Czech Republic]]'s top-tier [[Association football|football]] league. The defending champions were [[SK Slavia Prague|Slavia Prague]], who won their fourth Czech title the [[2016–17 Czech First League|previous season]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.ceskatelevize.cz/sport/fotbal/1-liga/355238-slavia-na-strahove-rozstrilela-brno-4-0-a-po-osmi-letech-dosahla-na-titul|title=Slavia na Strahově rozstřílela Brno 4:0 a po osmi letech dosáhla na titul|trans-title=Slavia Strahov blasted Brno 4:0 after eight years and reached the title|date=27 May 2017|work=[[ČT24]]|publisher=[[Czech Television]]|language=cs|access-date=18 June 2017}}</ref> The season began on 28 July 2017 and ended on 26 May 2018.

[[FC Viktoria Plzeň|Viktoria Plzeň]] made a league record by winning their first 14 league games of the season.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.radio.cz/en/section/news/plzen-equal-club-record-of-16-wins-in-succession|title=Plzeň equal club record of 16 wins in succession|date=19 November 2017|work=[[Radio Prague International]]|access-date=28 November 2017}}</ref>
